literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) reports a LRRC25-GFP C-terminal fusion that localizes to the HeLa cell membrane. LRRC25 is a Type I single-pass membrane protein: signal peptide residues 1–20 (cleaved), extracellular domain residues 21–165, TM residues 166–187, intracellular tail residues 188–305. The C-terminus (residue 305) is therefore intracellular, so the GFP in LRRC25-GFP is on the cytoplasmic face — not an extracellular surface tag. L1 cannot be used to derive a topology_derived extracellular site because the reported tag terminus is the intracellular one, not the extracellular mature N-terminus. No ledger line reports any insertion on the extracellular domain (residues 21–165) or at the mature N-terminus (after residue 20). Zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported.

literature_other_positions.note: LRRC25-GFP C-terminal fusion traffics to the plasma membrane in HeLa cells; GFP is appended after the last residue (H305) of the intracellular tail (residues 188–305), placing it on the cytoplasmic face — a valid intracellular label but not an extracellular surface tag site.
